mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, reducing tramadol metabolism to its active O-desmethyltramadol metabolite, potentially decreasing analgesic efficacy while increasing tramadol parent drug levels and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor for reduced analgesia and tramadol toxicity; consider alternative analgesic or adjust tramadol dosing with hepatic function assessment; counsel on CNS depression and seizure risk.
